choose.otherwise: c.lifecycle != 'PENDING_ASSIGNMENT' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM camera_user_channel_grant cg JOIN camera_channel granted ON granted.id=cg.channel_id WHERE cg.user_id=#{visibility.userId} AND (granted.id=c.id OR (c.device_id IS NOT NULL AND granted.device_id=c.device_id))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM camera_user_device_grant dg WHERE dg.user_id=#{visibility.userId} AND dg.device_id=c.device_id) OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM camera_channel grouped WHERE grouped.lifecycle != 'PENDING_ASSIGNMENT' AND (grouped.id=c.id OR (c.device_id IS NOT NULL AND grouped.device_id=c.device_id)) AND grouped.group_id IN #{gid}))

mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.group_id, AS device_key FROM camera_channel c WHERE c.group_id IS NOT NULL AND c.lifecycle != 'PENDING_ASSIGNMENT' AND () ORDER BY c.group_id,device_key LIMIT 10001

mapper.sql: CASE WHEN c.device_id IS NULL THEN c.name ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(d.local_name,''),CASE WHEN s.connection_category='DEVICE' THEN s.name ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(d.source_name,''),CONCAT('设备 ',d.id)) END) END
camera_channel c JOIN camera_source s ON s.id=c.source_id LEFT JOIN camera_device d ON d.id=c.device_id AND d.source_id=c.source_id
mapper.select: SELECT id,device_id,group_id,version,lifecycle,name FROM ( SELECT c.id,c.device_id,c.group_id,c.version,c.lifecycle, AS name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY c.device_id ORDER BY CASE c.lifecycle WHEN 'ENABLED' THEN 0 WHEN 'DISABLED' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,c.id) AS row_order FROM WHERE c.device_id IN #{id}1=0 ) candidates WHERE row_order=1 ORDER BY device_id
